proposed_capability: Route a winning shared household income recommendation through the existing exact-roster portrait selector.
player_save_control_impact: No game mutation during validation. The exact-build adapter must observe save admission, player activity and the active household before a single selection.
expected_outcome: Accept only the current arbitrated income handoff for the same save, build, scope, capture and ordered household. Validate selection before the next Sim is reconsidered for queue work.
negative_tests: Reject stale capture, wrong save or build, mismatched member order and unrelated or preempted recommendations.
Yield when target eligibility or selected Sim changes between captures. Require later recipient readback before considering queue work.
rollback_path: Revert repository commits. Existing ownership-scoped package rollback remains the native install path.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact-build EA selector, acknowledgment and Windows disposable-save proof require local issue #171.
